newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: CRICKET-INDIAN SPINNERS HAVE WEST INDIES IN TROUBLE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIAN SPINNERS HAVE WEST INDIES IN TROUBLE.

text.p: India's spinners Anil Kumble and Sunil Joshi quickly had West Indies in trouble at 61 for three on the first morning of the second test at the Queen's Park Oval on friday.
Leg-spinner Kumble removed openers Stuart Williams and Sherwin Campbell before left-arm spinner Joshi claimed the prized wicket of Brian Lara.
Williams was caught off bat and pad by Rahul Dravid at silly mid-off for 18 and Campbell followed soon after, caught for eight at extra cover by Venkat Prasad trying to turn Kumble to the on-side.
Lara also fell cheaply, edging to a diving Mohammed Azharuddin at first slip while attempting to drive a ball from Joshi. Lara never looked comfortable, facing 51 balls for his 14 runs in 65 minutes.
At lunch Kumble had taken two for 24 from nine overs.
